text.ms:
1. (1) Kaedah-kaedah ini bolehlah dinamakan Kaedah-Kaedah Pengangkutan

Jalan (Mata Demerit) 2017.

(2) Kaedah-Kaedah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 6 April 2017.

Tafsiran

2. Dalam Kaedah-Kaedah ini, "kesalahan berjadual" ertinya mana-mana kesalahan

yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

Pemakluman kepada Ketua Pengarah

3. (1) Jika seseorang pemegang lesen memandu—

(a) telah disabitkan atas mana-mana kesalahan berjadual; atau

(b) telah dikompaun bagi mana-mana kesalahan berjadual dan telah

membayar kompaun itu,

Ketua Pengarah hendaklah dimaklumkan mengenai butir-butir sabitan atau kompaun

itu berkenaan dengan pemegang lesen memandu itu.

(2) Pemakluman di bawah subkaedah (1) hendaklah dibuat oleh Pengarah,

Ketua Pegawai Polis, Dato Bandar, Perbadanan Putrajaya, Datuk Bandar Majlis

Bandaraya, Yang Dipertua Majlis Perbandaran, Pengerusi Majlis Perbandaran atau

Ketua Pengarah Lembaga Lebuhraya Malaysia, mengikut mana-mana yang berkenaan.

Pemberian mata demerit dan rekod

4. (1) Setelah menerima pemberitahuan di bawah kaedah 3, Ketua Pengarah

hendaklah memberikan mata demerit sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual

kepada pemegang lesen memandu itu.

(2) Ketua Pengarah hendaklah merekodkan mata demerit yang diberikan

di bawah subkaedah (1) dalam daftar pemegang lesen memandu.

(3) Mata demerit yang diberikan di bawah subkaedah (1) hendaklah mula

berkuat kuasa dari tarikh kesalahan berjadual dilakukan.

Penggantungan dan pembatalan lesen memandu selain lesen memandu

percubaan

5. (1) Jika seseorang pemegang lesen memandu selain lesen memandu

percubaan telah diberikan sejumlah dua puluh atau lebih mata demerit terkumpul,

Ketua Pengarah boleh menggantung lesen memandu pemegang lesen itu.

(2) Penggantungan lesen memandu di bawah subkaedah (1) hendaklah—

(a) dalam hal penggantungan pertama, selama suatu tempoh yang

tidak kurang daripada enam bulan tetapi tidak lebih daripada

lapan bulan;

(b) dalam hal penggantungan kedua, selama suatu tempoh yang tidak

kurang daripada lapan bulan tetapi tidak lebih daripada sepuluh

bulan; dan

(c) dalam hal penggantungan ketiga atau lebih, selama suatu tempoh

yang tidak kurang daripada sepuluh bulan tetapi tidak lebih

daripada dua belas bulan.

(3) Tertakluk kepada subkaedah (4), jika seorang pemegang lesen memandu

yang telah diberikan mata demerit—

(a) tidak disabitkan atas mana-mana kesalahan berjadual atau tidak

dikompaun bagi mana-mana kesalahan berjadual selama tempoh

dua belas bulan berturut-turut daripada tarikh terakhir orang itu

melakukan suatu kesalahan berjadual; dan

(b) telah, jika dikehendaki oleh Ketua Pengarah, menghadiri kursus

pemulihan yang diluluskan oleh Ketua Pengarah,

Ketua Pengarah boleh memotong sejumlah tidak melebihi lima puluh peratus mata

demerit daripada jumah mata demerit terkumpul pemegang lesen memandu itu.

(4) Perenggan (3)(a) tidak terpakai jika pemegang lesen memandu itu

melakukan mana-mana kesalahan berjadual dalam tempoh dua belas bulan

berturut-turut yang disebut dalam perenggan itu tetapi dia hanya disabitkan atau

dikompaun bagi kesalahan itu dan diberikan mata demerit selepas tempoh dua belas

bulan berturut-turut itu.

(5) Jika seseorang yang lesen memandunya digantung di bawah kaedah ini

diberikan mata demerit bagi kesalahan berjadual yang dilakukan semasa tempoh

penggantungannya, mata demerit yang diberikan—

(a) tidak boleh diambil kira bagi maksud pembatalan mata demerit

di akhir tempoh penggantungan; dan

(b) tertakluk kepada subkaedah (6), akan, jika dikumpulkan sebanyak

dua puluh mata demerit atau lebih, menjadikan lesen memandu

orang itu digantung selanjutnya oleh Ketua Pengarah mengikut

subkaedah (1).

(6) Jika lesen memandu seseorang itu digantung di bawah kaedah ini untuk

kali ketiga dalam tempoh lima tahun, Ketua Pengarah hendaklah membatalkan lesen

memandu orang itu.

Pembatalan lesen memandu percubaan

6. (1) Jika seorang pemegang lesen memandu percubaan telah diberikan dua

puluh atau lebih mata demerit terkumpul, Ketua Pengarah hendaklah membatalkan

lesen memandu percubaan orang itu.

(2) Dalam hal jika seorang pemegang lesen memandu percubaan diberikan

lesen memandu, apa-apa mata demerit yang diberikan kepada orang itu semasa orang

itu memegang lesen memandu percubaan hendaklah kekal direkodkan atas namanya

dalam daftar pemegang lesen memandu.

(3) Jika seseorang yang telah diberi lesen memandu diberikan mata demerit

bagi kesalahan berjadual yang dilakukan semasa orang itu memegang lesen memandu

percubaan dan mata demerit itu akan, jika diambil kira dengan mata demerit yang

diberikan semasa orang itu memegang lesen memandu percubaan, terjumlah kepada

dua puluh mata demerit atau lebih, Ketua Pengarah boleh membatalkan lesen memandu

yang diberikan kepada orang itu.

(4) Jika sesuatu lesen memandu percubaan dibatalkan di bawah kaedah ini,

setiap mata demerit yang diberikan kepada pemegang lesen memandu percubaan itu

hendaklah dibatalkan.

Penyerahan lesen memandu

7. (1) Mana-mana orang yang menerima notis secara bertulis bagi

penggantungan atau pembatalan lesen memandu di bawah subseksyen 37(1) Akta

hendaklah, dalam tempoh dua puluh satu hari dari tarikh penyampaian notis itu,

menyerahkan lesen memandunya di mana-mana cawangan Jabatan Pengangkutan Jalan

atau di mana-mana tempat lain yang diluluskan oleh Ketua Pengarah.

(2) Penggantungan dan pembatalan suatu lesen memandu hendaklah mula

berkuat kuasa pada tarikh penyerahan lesen memandu atau di akhir tempoh dua puluh

satu hari dari tarikh penyampaian notis, mengikut mana-mana yang terdahulu.

Kesan penggantungan dan pembatalan lesen memandu

8. (1) Mana-mana orang yang lesen memandunya digantung di bawah

Kaedah-Kaedah ini tidak boleh memandu suatu kenderaan motor di bawah apa-apa

lesen memandu, termasuk lesen memandu yang dikeluarkan oleh mana-mana pihak

berkuasa lain, atau mendapatkan lesen memandu sepanjang tempoh

penggantungannya.

(2) Mana-mana orang yang lesen memandunya dibatalkan di bawah

Kaedah-Kaedah ini tidak boleh memandu suatu kenderaan motor di bawah apa-apa

lesen memandu, termasuk lesen memandu yang dikeluarkan oleh mana-mana pihak

berkuasa lain, atau mendapatkan lesen memandu bagi tempoh dua belas bulan dari

tarikh pembatalan lesen.

(3) Walau apa pun kaedah ini, Ketua Pengarah boleh menolak atau

menggantung apa-apa urusan atau transaksi yang terpakai bagi orang itu di bawah

Akta.

Peruntukan peralihan

9. (1) Kaedah-Kaedah Kenderaan Motor (Mata Demerit) 1997

[P.U. (A) 79/1997] (selepas ini disebut "Kaedah-Kaedah yang dibatalkan") dibatalkan.

(2) Apa-apa mata demerit yang diberikan di bawah Kaedah-Kaedah yang

dibatalkan hendaklah, pada tarikh permulaan kuat kuasa Kaedah-Kaedah ini, terbatal

dan tidak boleh diambil kira dalam pengiraan mata demerit di bawah Kaedah-Kaedah

ini.

(3) Apa-apa notis penggantungan yang dihantar di bawah Kaedah-Kaedah

yang dibatalkan sebelum permulaan kuat kuasa Kaedah-Kaedah ini hendaklah terbatal

dan tidak boleh diambil kira dalam pengiraan penggantungan selanjutnya atau

pembatalan di bawah Kaedah-Kaedah ini.

(4) Apa-apa tempoh penggantungan di bawah Kaedah-Kaedah yang

dibatalkan yang masih berkuat kuasa hendaklah, pada tarikh permulaan kuat kuasa

Kaedah-Kaedah ini, ditamatkan dan tidak boleh diambil kira dalam pengiraan

penggantungan selanjutnya atau pembatalan di bawah Kaedah-Kaedah ini.

(5) Apa-apa rekod yang dibuat di bawah Kaedah-Kaedah yang dibatalkan

hendaklah, pada tarikh permulaan kuat kuasa Kaedah-Kaedah ini, terus disimpan di

bawah Kaedah-Kaedah ini.

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

ROAD TRANSPORT (DEMERIT POINTS) RULES 2017

IN exercise of the power conferred by subsections 35(2) and 35A(2) of

the Road Transport Act 1987 [Act 333], the Minister makes the following rules:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These rules may be cited as the Road Transport (Demerit Points)

Rules 2017.

(2) These Rules come into operation on 6 April 2017.

Interpretation

2. In these Rules, "scheduled offence" means any offence specified in the Schedule.

Notification to Director General

3. (1) Where a holder of a driving licence—

(a) has been convicted of any scheduled offence; or

(b) has been compounded for any scheduled offence and has paid that

compound,

the Director General shall be notified of the particulars of the conviction or compound in

respect of the holder of the driving licence.

(2) The notification under subrule (1) shall be made by the Director, Chief

Police Officer, Dato Bandar, Perbadanan Putrajaya, Mayor of a City Council, President of

a Municipal Council, Chairman of a Municipal Council or Director General of the

Highway Authority Malaysia, as the case may be.

Award of demerit points and records

4. (1) Upon receipt of notification under rule 3, the Director General shall award

demerit points as set out in the Schedule against the holder of the driving licence.

(2) The Director General shall record the demerit points awarded under

subrule (1) in the register of holders of driving licences.

(3) The demerit points awarded under subrule (1) shall take effect from the

date of the commission of the scheduled offence.

Suspension and revocation of driving licence other than probationary driving

licence

5. (1) Where a holder of a driving licence other than probationary driving

licence has been awarded a total number of twenty or more accumulated demerit

points, the Director General may suspend the driving licence of the holder of the driving

licence.

(2) The suspension of a driving licence under subrule (1) shall be—

(a) in the case of first suspension, for a period of not less than six

months but not more than eight months;

(b) in the case of second suspension, for a period of not less than eight

months but not more than ten months; and

(c) in the case of third suspension or more, for a period of not less

than ten months but not more than twelve months.

(3) Subject to subrule (4), if a holder of a driving licence who has been

awarded demerit points

(a) is not convicted of any scheduled offence or has not been

compounded for any scheduled offence for a period of twelve

consecutive months from the date of his last commission of a

scheduled offence; and

(b) has, if required by the Director General, attended a rehabilitation

course as approved by the Director General,

the Director General may deduct a total of not exceeding fifty percent of the demerit

points from the total demerit points accumulated by the holder of the driving licence.

(4) Paragraph (3)(a) shall not apply if the holder of a driving licence commits

any scheduled offence during the period of twelve consecutive months referred to in

that paragraph but he is only convicted of or compounded for that offence and awarded

demerit points after that period of twelve consecutive months.

(5) Where a person whose driving licence is suspended under this rule is

awarded demerit points for a scheduled offence committed during the period of

suspension, the demerit points awarded—

(a) shall not be taken into account for the purpose of cancellation of

demerit points at the end of the period of suspension; and

(b) subject to subrule (6), would, if accumulated to twenty demerit

points or more, render his driving licence to be further suspended

by the Director General in accordance with subrule (1).

(6) Where a person's driving licence is suspended under this rule for the

third time in a period of five years, the Director General shall revoke the person's

driving licence.

Revocation of probationary driving licence

6. (1) Where a holder of a probationary driving licence has been awarded a total

number of twenty or more accumulated demerit points, the Director General shall

revoke the person's probationary driving licence.

(2) In the case where a holder of a probationary driving licence is granted a

driving licence, any demerit points awarded against him when he was holding the

probationary licence shall remain recorded as against his name in the register of

holders of driving licences.

(3) Where a person who has been granted a driving licence is awarded

demerit points for a scheduled offence committed when he was holding a probationary

driving licence and the demerit points would, if taken into account with the demerit

points awarded when he was holding the probationary driving licence, amount to

twenty demerit points or more, the Director General may revoke the driving licence

granted to the person.

(4) Where a probationary driving licence is revoked under this rule, every

demerit point awarded against the holder of the probationary licence shall be cancelled.

Surrender of driving licence

7. (1) Any person who receives a notice in writing of a suspension or revocation

of a driving licence under subsection 37(1) of the Act shall, within twenty-one days from

the date of service of the notice, surrender the driving licence at any branch of the Road

Transport Department or at any other places approved by the Director General.

(2) The suspension or revocation of a driving licence shall take effect on the

date of the surrender of the driving licence or at the end of the period of twenty-one

days from the date of service of the notice, whichever is earlier.

Effect of suspension and revocation of driving licence

8. (1) Any person whose driving licence is suspended under these Rules shall

not drive a motor vehicle under any driving licence, including a driving licence issued by

any other authority, or obtain a driving licence during the period of suspension.

(2) Any person whose driving licence is revoked under these Rules shall not

drive a motor vehicle under any driving licence, including a driving licence issued by

any other authority, or obtain a driving licence for a period of twelve months from the

date of revocation of the licence.

(3) Notwithstanding this rule, the Director General may refuse or suspend

any dealing or transaction applicable to the person under the Act.

Revocation and transitional provisions

9. (1) The Motor Vehicles (Demerit Points) Rules 1997 [P.U. (A) 79/1997]

(hereinafter referred to as "the revoked Rules") is revoked.

(2) Any demerit points awarded under the revoked Rules shall, on the date of

coming into operation of these Rules, be cancelled and shall not be taken into account in

the computation of demerit points under these Rules.

(3) Any notice of suspension sent to any person under the revoked Rules

before the coming into operation of these Rules shall be revoked and shall not be taken

into account in the computation of a further suspension or for revocation under these

Rules.

(4) Any period of suspension under the revoked Rules which is still in

operation shall, on the date of coming into operation of these Rules, be terminated and

shall not be taken into account in the computation of a further suspension or for

revocation under these Rules.

(5) Any record made under the revoked Rules shall, on the date of coming

into operation of these Rules, continue to be kept under these Rules.
